measures.sql: CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38,9)) / NULLIF(CAST("source_total" AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9)))

cases.sourceOracle:
WITH source AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS value FROM analytics_mc26_share WHERE channel='keep' GROUP BY region)
      SELECT region, CAST(value AS DECIMAL(38,9))/NULLIF(CAST((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM analytics_mc26_share WHERE channel='keep') AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS value
      FROM source WHERE value > 100 ORDER BY region
cases.query:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  analytics_mc26_share.region AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", MEASURE(analytics_mc26_share.value) AS "analytics_mc26_share.value", MEASURE(analytics_mc26_share.share) AS "analytics_mc26_share.share"
  FROM analytics_mc26_share
  GROUP BY 1
),
filtered AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", base."analytics_mc26_share.value" AS "analytics_mc26_share.value", base."analytics_mc26_share.share" AS "analytics_mc26_share.share"
  FROM base
  WHERE base."analytics_mc26_share.value" > '100'
)
SELECT
  filtered."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", filtered."analytics_mc26_share.value" AS "analytics_mc26_share.value", filtered."analytics_mc26_share.share" AS "analytics_mc26_share.share"
  FROM filtered
  ORDER BY "analytics_mc26_share.region"

measures.sql: CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38,9)) / NULLIF(CAST("source_total" AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9)))

cases.sourceOracle:
WITH source AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS value FROM analytics_mc26_share WHERE channel='keep' GROUP BY region)
      SELECT region, CAST(value AS DECIMAL(38,9))/NULLIF(CAST((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM analytics_mc26_share WHERE channel='keep') AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS value
      FROM source WHERE value > 100 ORDER BY region
cases.query:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  analytics_mc26_share.region AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", MEASURE(analytics_mc26_share.value) AS "value"
  FROM analytics_mc26_share
  GROUP BY 1
),
scope AS (
SELECT
  MEASURE(analytics_mc26_share.value) AS "source_total"
  FROM analytics_mc26_share
),
combined AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", base."value" AS "value", scope."source_total" AS "source_total"
  FROM base CROSS JOIN scope
),
derived AS (
SELECT
  combined."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", combined."value" AS "value", combined."source_total" AS "source_total", CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38,9)) / NULLIF(CAST("source_total" AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS "local_value"
  FROM combined
),
filtered AS (
SELECT
  derived."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", derived."value" AS "value", derived."source_total" AS "source_total", derived."local_value" AS "local_value"
  FROM derived
  WHERE derived."value" > '100'
)
SELECT
  filtered."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", filtered."value" AS "value", filtered."local_value" AS "local_value"
  FROM filtered
  ORDER BY "analytics_mc26_share.region"

measures.sql: CAST((CAST("current" AS DECIMAL(38,9))-CAST("prior" AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS DECIMAL(38,9)) / NULLIF(CAST("prior" AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9)))

cases.sourceOracle:
WITH source AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', occurred_at) AS bucket, SUM(amount) AS value
      FROM analytics_mc26_calendar WHERE channel='keep' AND occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-04-01' GROUP BY 1)
      SELECT current.bucket, (CAST(current.value AS DECIMAL(38,9))-CAST(prior.value AS DECIMAL(38,9)))/NULLIF(CAST(prior.value AS DECIMAL(38,9)),CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS value
      FROM source current LEFT JOIN source prior ON prior.bucket=current.bucket-INTERVAL '1 month' WHERE current.value > 250 ORDER BY current.bucket
cases.query:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at) AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", MEASURE(analytics_mc26_calendar.current) AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.current", MEASURE(analytics_mc26_calendar.growth) AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.growth"
  FROM analytics_mc26_calendar
  WHERE (analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at >= '2024-01-01' AND analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at <= '2024-03-31')
  GROUP BY 1
),
filtered AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", base."analytics_mc26_calendar.current" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.current", base."analytics_mc26_calendar.growth" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.growth"
  FROM base
  WHERE base."analytics_mc26_calendar.current" > '250'
)
SELECT
  filtered."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", filtered."analytics_mc26_calendar.current" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.current", filtered."analytics_mc26_calendar.growth" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.growth"
  FROM filtered
  ORDER BY "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at"

WITH source AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', occurred_at) AS bucket, SUM(amount) AS value
      FROM analytics_mc26_calendar WHERE channel='keep' AND occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-04-01' GROUP BY 1)
      SELECT current.bucket, (CAST(current.value AS DECIMAL(38,9))-CAST(prior.value AS DECIMAL(38,9)))/NULLIF(CAST(prior.value AS DECIMAL(38,9)),CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS value

cases.query:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at) AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", MEASURE(analytics_mc26_calendar.current) AS "current"
  FROM analytics_mc26_calendar
  WHERE (analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at >= '2023-12-01' AND analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at <= '2024-03-31')
  GROUP BY 1
),
calendar_keys AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", base."current" AS "current", DATE_ADD(base."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", INTERVAL '-1 month') AS "__calendar_1"
  FROM base
),
compared AS (
SELECT
  t."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", t."current" AS "current", cmp_1."current" AS "prior"
  FROM calendar_keys t LEFT JOIN calendar_keys cmp_1 ON cmp_1."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" = t."__calendar_1"
  WHERE (t."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" >= '2024-01-01' AND t."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" <= '2024-03-31')
),
derived AS (
SELECT
  compared."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", compared."current" AS "current", compared."prior" AS "prior", CAST((CAST("current" AS DECIMAL(38,9))-CAST("prior" AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS DECIMAL(38,9)) / NULLIF(CAST("prior" AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS "local_value"
  FROM compared
),
filtered AS (
SELECT
  derived."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", derived."current" AS "current", derived."prior" AS "prior", derived."local_value" AS "local_value"
  FROM derived
  WHERE derived."current" > '250'
)
SELECT
  filtered."analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at" AS "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at", filtered."current" AS "current", filtered."local_value" AS "local_value"
  FROM filtered
  ORDER BY "analytics_mc26_calendar.occurred_at"

measures.sql: CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38,9)) / NULLIF(CAST("retained_total" AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9)))

cases.sourceOracle:
WITH retained AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM analytics_mc26_share
        WHERE channel='keep' GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount)>100)
        SELECT region, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(38,9))/NULLIF(CAST((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM retained) AS DECIMAL(38,9)),CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS value
        FROM retained ORDER BY region
cases.query:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  analytics_mc26_share.region AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", MEASURE(analytics_mc26_share.value) AS "value"
  FROM analytics_mc26_share
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING MEASURE(analytics_mc26_share.value) > '100'
),
windowed AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", base."value" AS "value", SUM(base."value") OVER (ORDER BY base."analytics_mc26_share.region" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS "retained_total"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  windowed."analytics_mc26_share.region" AS "analytics_mc26_share.region", windowed."value" AS "value", CAST("value" AS DECIMAL(38,9)) / NULLIF(CAST("retained_total" AS DECIMAL(38,9)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,9))) AS "local_value"
  FROM windowed
  ORDER BY "analytics_mc26_share.region"
